steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: Say that again!

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: The Vanguards will not be retrieving Leonid's corpse. Did you get it this time?

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: His corpse? He's warming himself up by the fireplace right now, laughing at idiots like you!

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: You just want to wait here your whole life, fighting over scraps of food and firewood!

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: I knew you Vanguards were useless imbeciles the moment you started yelling about rescuing Lavrya by force!

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Go ahead then, go kneel before those thugs. I want to see if you really can get out, or if you'll be sent back like Shorty.

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: We're off—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hold it!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Where are you going? You think those assholes will listen to you?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You guys really are still stuck in the same rut, huh...

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: Rosalind? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I came to help Sonya, and to stop you dumbasses from throwing your lives away while I'm at it!

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Hmph. Why worry about what they're doing...?

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Yesterday, when that guy named Fedya carried Shorty's body back, they were still making snide remarks.

steps.name: Melancholy Youth
steps.text: ...Listen, it is dangerous out there. Those thugs will not let you walk away, no matter how much you pay them.

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: You think it's true just because you said so? Who the hell do you think you are? You saw Shorty bribe them with your own eyes, did you?

steps.name: Melancholy Youth
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: His pockets were so clean, not even lice would live in them. How could he ever come up with the idea of bribing someone? He must have been killed when trying to break out.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That's just a guess, but those guys who call themselves the 'Council of Sixteen' aren't the kind of people you can bargain with.

steps.name: Worried Student
steps.text: Sonya... When you were away, someone sent us a letter. It's from Naum, from the Symposium.

steps.name: Worried Student
steps.text: He writes: 'The leader of the Council of Sixteen, Gromov, is a reasonable man. So long as you have enough money, we can walk free.'

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Where's the letter?

steps.name: Worried Student
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: Is that all? Are we done? Just let us leave this damned place already.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: You've got no grounds to stop us, Sonya! Not even you!

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: Out of our way!
He rashly pushes his way through the crowd, reaching out to grab hold of Zima's sleeve.
Blam! A loud slap slams into his face.
It is almost as if the slap has pushed some button, when everyone grinds to a halt.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Wake up already! Don't you understand what this letter means?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You Symposium people are writing day in, day out. Would any of you have handwriting this sloppy? It's practically going off the page. The best possible outcome here is that he's trading your lives for a meal.

steps.name: Symposium Member
steps.text: That's not true—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You seriously haven't figured it out? Or do you like keeping your head stuck in the sand? Still stubbornly believing in a way out of here that doesn't involve fighting back?

steps.name: Worried Student
steps.text: Then... What should we do?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Save lives.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: This letter and Shorty should be enough proof that the Council of Sixteen is dangerous. We can't just sit by and watch as Leonid drags a bunch of people to their deaths.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If only one of them still lives, I'll bring them back. If they're all still alive, I'll bring them all back.

spans.text: If only one of them still lives, I'll bring them back. If they're all still alive, I'll bring them

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Do you have a death wish too, Sonya?

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: If they got caught, that's just proof they were stupid and weak. They deserve to die—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Shut up, Faddey.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm sick of you always insulting the other students. We need unity, if we want to keep everyone alive.

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Unity? Hah! This empire was built by throwing weaklings like these Symposians into the river, one by one!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So, when Ursus finally got thrown into the river, you got pulled along with it, huh?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: There's no Vanguard or Symposium here. No nobles or commoners.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: There's only one thing we are in the eyes of that 'Council of Sixteen': fresh meat ready for butchering.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yesterday, they killed Shorty. Tomorrow, they'll squish each and every one of our heads like helpless bugs. And right now, we're bickering our asses off. They don't need to split us up, we're doing it for them.

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Even so, those slowing us down—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What about you, Faddey?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: When have you ever contributed a damn thing? Or is your 'greatness' just an empty shell, only able to be filled by watching the weak fall apart?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Keep your stupid superiority complex, it'll keep you company while you wait to turn into a corpse!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: As for everyone else... If you don't feel like dying a miserable death in a place like this, grab something you can crack a few skulls with.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm not asking you all to like the Symposium or anyone else, not even for a second... but right now, you gotta keep up with me if you want everyone to live!
The air seems to have frozen as she finishes her speech. Nobody dares to break the silence.
Until Leto spots a hand. A student cautiously raises his hand, the hesitance still clear on his face. But he is the first of his peers to answer her.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: 'Pencil Stub'! 'Pencil Stub', right? Whaddya feel like saying?

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: I... support Sonya's idea.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: Those who left are our peers, our friends. We can't abandon them.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: But if possible, call me by my real name. I'm—

steps.name: Excited Student
steps.text: I support her too! Whether they're dead or alive, I just want to see how they really are!

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: I'm with her—
Several students stand up, then more, and even more. They gather by Sonya's side.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Good. Ten or so of you should be enough to make a scouting party.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I know a lot of you are still skeptical, but don't worry. I'll bring an answer back to you.

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: ...Count me in.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Are you thinking of—

steps.name: Faddey
steps.text: Don't overthink it. I just want to prove I'm right, so I can slap those Symposium cowards in the face.

steps.name: 'Pencil Stub'
steps.text: So, what do we do? Just give us the order, Sonya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: First, we need to find a route we can use to flank the Council of Sixteen—

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Err, Antosha told me to send you guys some supplies.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Have I come at a bad time?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Perfect timing, actually. I was just thinking of going to your camp to get a guide, Matvey.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If a fight breaks out, I'll make sure you're safe.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Don't underestimate me, Sonya.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Antosha wants to kill Gromov, but we were never able to find his lair.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: But luckily, our attempts to scout it out have led us to several of the thugs' active bases. We've got their details down—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Trouble up ahead, Sonya!

steps.name: Anxious Noble Student
steps.text: Suka! They're getting closer!

steps.name: Anxious Noble Student
steps.text: What do we do, Nika? You always have ideas.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Don't panic, Yeremey, in just a moment—

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: The door bolt won't hold much longer!

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: What about the window, Nika? If we can't hold here, can we—

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: No go. There's two of them outside the window, and they've got steel pipes.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Come here and help me brace against this table. It's our last line of defense.
Her voice wavers as she thrusts a shiny kitchen knife into her friend's hands, pressing both hands down on the table corner like her life depends on it.
Yeremey takes a deep breath, pushing against the table's edge with his entire body. Though his forehead is covered in cold sweat, his face does not show a hint of cowardice.

steps.name: Thug at the Door A
steps.text: Hey there, honored 'guests'.

steps.name: Thug at the Door A
steps.text: Don't bother trying to resist. We just wanna talk 'business'.

steps.name: Thug at the Door B
steps.text: Yeah, it's below twenty out here. Let us in already, we're freezing. Is this how kids these days treat visitors?

steps.name: Thug at the Door A
steps.text: If you don't open up, our 'service charge' is gonna go up to... say, an arm.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Get lost!

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: There's a ton of Originium-tipped bolts in this room pointed right at the door! Come any closer and you die!

steps.name: Thug at the Door A
steps.text: Pfft. Originium-tipped bolts? You hear that, Pacient? She's got Originium-tipped bolts!

steps.name: Thug at the Door B
steps.text: Oooh, I'm so scared! Hahahaha—

steps.name: Thug at the Door B
steps.text: I'd believe you if you said you managed to rustle up some borscht in this cesspit, but Originium-tipped bolts? Pull the other one. I've already taken the Originium out of every contraption in the area.

steps.name: Thug at the Door A
steps.text: Well, if you kids don't want to play nice, then don't blame us for what's next.

steps.name: Thug at the Door A
steps.text: Remember, keep them alive, otherwise we can't answer to the boss. You're up first, Pacient!
It feels as if every swing of the axe is hacking at the students' minds. A crack opens up in the door, and a filthy, tattooed hand forces its way in, trying to unlatch the bolt.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: (Quietly) Now.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Here's a one-way trip back to the hospital, Pacient!
He bellows as he lunges at the trespassing hand, stabbing it with his knife.

steps.name: Thug at the Door B
steps.text: Argh! My hand! That punk actually stabbed me!

steps.name: Thug at the Door A
steps.text: Smash the door down! Skin those little bastards alive!
The axe blows intensify, the wooden door now riddled with cracks. Snow-laden wind pours into the room as several tall shadows gather around the door, forming a wall of despair.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: ...Listen, Yeremey.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: If they catch us, they'll take us back and torture us... so don't hesitate, whether you have to do it to me, or to yourself.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Nika, if we live through this, I—

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Save it for after we live through it! They're coming! Aim for the throat!

spans.text: we live through it! They're coming! Aim for the throat!

steps.text: The thugs grin wickedly as they pass through the doorframe, brandishing their steel pipes. Yeremey closes his eyes in desperation, readying his crude weapon for one last strike—
But the pain never comes. The Ursus who was oh-so arrogant earlier flies through the air like a burlap sack, slamming into the snow-covered ground outside. There is no further movement from him.

steps.name: Thug at the Door B
steps.text: Who dares—ARGKH!
I do. Got that?
The tall figure blocking the doorway does not even have time to turn his head before a hand bashes it against the frame.
Zima steps over his collapsed body, flicking the blood off her hands.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Y-You're...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey hey, General Zima's here to save you.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Finally—
She cannot stop the tears from flowing, her tense shoulders collapsing from relief.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Don't worry, just take your time telling us what happened. We're here to help.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Were you with Leonid?

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Leonid?

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: He's dead...

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Those bastards came up with something: an 'auction'.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Their boss Gromov cheated us. He said we'd be able to buy our freedom as long as we had enough money.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: But it was all a lie. It turned into a slaughterhouse.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Gromov had his people grade everyone like meatbeasts. The nobles with money were led to a building, and the commoners... I don't know what happened to them.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: Thankfully, Yeremey was suspicious, and he didn't go straight in. We had to run for our lives to escape their pursuit.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: As for Leonid, he was full of confidence when he tried to 'discuss' things with Gromov...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: He's buried here?

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Da, behind the building.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Nika and I both saw it. One of the bastards dragged him over and was looting him for his clothes and watch.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: At the time, we thought we had managed to escape their base. Seeing that made me feel faint.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Nika grabbed a crowbar and gave that scumbag a surprise attack when he wasn't looking.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: We hid in his house, and we made it through the night, but we never expected his friends to show up at the door on the second day.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: I killed a man... but this was the only way we could avenge Leonid.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Something's off.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: We're still some distance away from the gang's base. They might come here on occasion to loot things, but they'd never actually live here, but you said this was one of their houses...

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: But he took a spade and some rations from this house. I thought—

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: No need to be so tense. Where did you bury him? I want to confirm his identity.
Why... are there corpses by the door?
...What did you people do to my house?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Your house, gospozha?

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: Where... Where's my husband? Have you seen him? He's just an ordinary worker, wearing a gray jacket. It's the last bit of warm clothing we have...
All the color drains out of Nika and Yeremey's faces in an instant. They give a subconscious glance towards the mound of dirt.

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: Y-You don't mean—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Dig him up.
The first thing to be unearthed is the deceased's patchwork gray jacket, followed by his cheeks, his head... and the dark red crack across his temple.
The woman crouches by her husband, her body shaking like a rusty machine as she strokes his face. It is the coldest thing she has touched in her entire life.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: I-I didn't know, I really didn't.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: We thought he was with that Council of Sixteen because he was taking Leonid's clothes!

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: Council? Clothes?

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: Why can't we take things off the dead people Gromov kills?

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: We've been doing this for two whole months since they stopped all work here! What's wrong with making a living?! What do you know?!

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: You... You students, you murderers—

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: We're not—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We're very sorry, gospozha.

steps.name: Yeremey
steps.text: Forgive me, madam... Here, this watch is pure gold! And these silver coins... Take them! Please don't cry!

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: I'm so, so sorry! There's also these things we took from those thugs.
Without a word, Sonya pulled out her rations and essentials, placing them before the woman.
The other students were stunned for a moment, then silently began offering up whatever supplies they had managed to find.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Ma'am. We were locked in here not long ago and had no idea what it was really like. Those atrocities... everyone has been on edge.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But regardless... we made mistakes, and we will take responsibility for them.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We will accept whatever punishment you deem fit.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Please, take this as a token of our regret... Our camp is just nearby. We will do everything we can to help you and your child get through this.

steps.name: Nika
steps.text: I am truly sorry. I was the one who acted. It had nothing to do with Yeremey, Sonya, or the others. If you must punish someone, punish—
The woman lifts her head. There is no desire in her eyes, merely an empty hate.
She grabs the coins and the watch, throwing them at Nika's face.

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: GET OUT!

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: Take your blood money with you! You think you can buy Ivan's life with these pieces of metal? You think it will bring back the father of my children?!

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: You can do anything, can't you? You dare to kill, yes? Then why didn't you dare to kill the man who did all of this? You can all go to hell!

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: If we weren't forced to live like this... Why would my husband become a robber and rob the dead of their clothes? Why would we have to become such wretched things...?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If it'll bring you some peace or closure, we'll do it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Both for you, and for our friends... I swear to you, Gromov, who caused all of this, will die this winter.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Please, take care of yourself... When we smash open the gate to the quarantine zone, we will all get out of here together.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: If that's the case...

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Have Nika and Yeremey show you the way, Sonya. I'll head back and get help from Antosha.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Everyone else, with me. This is our new mission.
She pulls up Nika, slumped against the ground. She leads the students into the snowstorm, where they fade from sight.

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: (Sobs)...

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: Wh-Why are you still here? To laugh at me?!

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Not long after I was born, my mother had to bury my father on her own. He was killed by bandits.

steps.name: Haggard Worker
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Your husband was no criminal, and he never hurt anyone. He fought for you and your children, until the very end.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Don't let his sacrifice be in vain. Take everything he fought so hard for... and live.
He takes the gold watch she threw away, forcing it into the icy palm of her hand, and folds her fingers around it.
